name: vscode-debugger-mcp
description: Exposes the VS Code debugger to AI agents over MCP: breakpoints, run, step, call stack, variables, evaluate.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Debugging runs workspace code, so the MCP server only starts in trusted workspaces.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.autoStart.description: Start the MCP server when the window opens.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.port.description: Loopback port for the MCP server. 0 picks a free port; the chosen port is injected into integrated terminals as VSCODE_DEBUG_MCP_PORT.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.requireToken.description: Require a per-window bearer token (injected as VSCODE_DEBUG_MCP_TOKEN) on every MCP request.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.allowMutation.description: Allow tools that can change debuggee state: set_variable and evaluate with the repl context.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.redactSecrets.description: Replace values of credential-looking variables (password, token, secret, api key) with a redaction marker.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.defaultTimeoutSeconds.description: How long blocking tools (continue, step, pause, wait_for_stop) wait for the debuggee to stop before returning a timeout outcome.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.startWaitSeconds.description: How long start_debugging waits for an initial stop (entry or breakpoint) before returning a running outcome.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.maxOutputEntries.description: Debug output entries retained for get_debug_output.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.activity.autoReveal.description: Open the Agent Activity output channel (without taking focus) on the first tool call after the window starts.

vscodeDebuggerMcp.activity.echoToDebugCo.description: Echo a one-line [agent] note to the Debug Console for calls that drive or change the session (execution, breakpoints, set_variable, evaluate).

vscodeDebuggerMcp.activity.maxRawChars.description: Maximum characters of each raw tool result shown in the Agent Activity channel. The agent still receives the full result.
